# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

We want a respectful, accessible, and technically rigorous community. Be
constructive, assume good faith while checking evidence, welcome different
experience levels, and discuss the work rather than the person.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, threats, sexualized
attention, publishing private information, deliberate disruption, or repeated
personal attacks.

## Scope and enforcement

This standard applies in repository issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions,
and project-related public spaces. Maintainers may edit or remove content and
temporarily or permanently restrict participation when behavior threatens the
community or project.

Report conduct concerns privately to the repository owner through an available
private contact channel. Do not publish sensitive reports in an issue. Reports
will be reviewed with attention to safety, privacy, context, and proportional
action.
